entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I ordered this jersey but it's just... I don't know. The whole process is confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yeah, I think so. It's VF88602. I'm just so lost with this stuff. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I've pulled up your order for the Aero Race Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? I guess? I mean, it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight and I can't really wear it. I was hoping I could do an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the website.
I completely understand. It sounds like a simple size issue. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I see here your order was delivered 36 days ago. According to our policy, you have 10 days to return an item. So, you're unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Absolutely. Since you just need a different size, I can process this as an exchange. We'll send you a pre-paid return label for the jersey that's too tight, and once we see it's on its way back, we'll ship the new size out to you. How does that sound?
Wow, yes! That's a huge relief. Thank you so much for making that so simple.
You're very welcome. I'm sending that return label to the email we have on file now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
